result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You went to the skin surgery clinic on 23 September 2026. The doctors removed the mole from your back. They closed the wound with 4 stitches.

The lab result for the mole is not known yet. It usually takes 2 to 3 weeks.

## What you need to do
1. Have your stitches removed at your GP surgery (family doctor) in 10 to 14 days.
2. Wait for the hospital to write to you and your GP with the result.

## Dates and medicines
- 23 September 2026: skin surgery clinic visit. The mole was removed.
- The letter lists no medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- How do I book the visit to have my stitches removed?
- How will I get the lab result?
- What should I do if I do not hear about the result after 3 weeks?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
